migration_report.title: SQL Server to PostgreSQL Migration Report - AdoCore Application

sql_statement_summary.manual_intervention_reason: DMS statement_conversion_tool consistently timed out (metadata model conversion did not complete). DMS schema_mapping_tool succeeded and was used for target schema names.
sql_statement_summary.equivalency_error_reason: SQL Equivalency tool returned ERROR status for all 7 pairs (consistent 'uniqueID' infrastructure error)

key_sql_conversions: DECLARE @var / variable assignment -> Separate NpgsqlCommand calls within app-level transaction
BEGIN TRANSACTION / COMMIT -> NpgsqlTransaction via BeginTransactionAsync()
Table/column names -> All lowercase per DMS schema mapping
CTE names -> Adjusted to avoid conflicts (ProductStats -> productstats_cte, ProductHistory -> producthistory_cte)
ROUND with integer division -> Added CAST(... AS NUMERIC) for PostgreSQL
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE -> CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION
Triggers -> PostgreSQL trigger function + CREATE TRIGGER pattern
IF NOT EXISTS (sys.objects) -> DROP TABLE IF EXISTS / CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS

changes: All 7 SQL statements converted to PostgreSQL
Transaction methods refactored to use app-level NpgsqlTransaction
MapProductFromReader column name references updated to lowercase (ProductId->productid, Name->name, etc.) to match PostgreSQL lowercase column naming
Connection strings updated from SQL Server format to PostgreSQL format
Full conversion to PostgreSQL DDL and function syntax
Full conversion to PostgreSQL DDL, functions, triggers, indexes, sample data
